title: Semicircle (half donut) Donut variant

complexity.rationale: The boolean/gray fill logic and slice-gap/stroke encodings already work unmodified for a half-arc, so no research is needed there. But rendering a true top-half gauge shape (not just a 180 degree arc floating in a full-size circle) requires new, non-precedented geometry: the arc/empty-state/summary anchor point must move from the container's vertical center to its bottom edge, and the outer-radius expression must use the full available height as the radius instead of half of it. Those are real design decisions with no existing precedent in donutUtils.ts to copy, hence a 3 rather than a 2.

summary: Adds a `variant: 'semicircle'` option to the S2 Donut that renders a top-half ('gauge style') arc instead of a full circle. Segments default to value-descending order, while `sortOrder: 'data'` preserves source order for ordinal categories. It keeps the central hole and DonutSummary support and works with `isBoolean`, but does not support SegmentLabel/rich segment labels in this iteration.
requirements: Add a `variant?: 'circle' | 'semicircle'` prop to Donut, defaulting to `'circle'` (fully backward compatible).
When `variant: 'semicircle'`, the pie transform sweeps 180 degrees (PI radians) instead of 360.

Default `startAngle` for `variant: 'semicircle'` is `-PI/2` (radians), so the first data row's segment starts at the 9 o'clock position and segments sweep clockwise through 12 o'clock to 3 o'clock, producing the classic top-half gauge silhouette. An explicit `startAngle` prop still overrides this.
Add a `sortOrder?: 'valueDescending' | 'data'` prop to Donut, defaulting to `'valueDescending'`.

When `variant: 'semicircle'` and `sortOrder: 'valueDescending'`, the largest value renders on the left, with decreasing values sweeping right. This is enforced by a descending metric sort transform ahead of the pie transform.
When `variant: 'semicircle'` and `sortOrder: 'data'`, no sort transform is added, preserving source order for ordinal categories such as Strongly agree through Strongly disagree.

The semicircle's flat edge sits at the bottom of the chart's plotting area; the arc's radius scales to use the full available height (not half, as the full-circle variant does), so the half-donut fills the available vertical space instead of leaving the bottom half of the bounding box empty.
The central hole (holeRatio) is retained identically to the circle variant - same ring-width/slice-gap tiering, same hole-ratio math, just applied to a half sweep.
DonutSummary continues to work with `variant: 'semicircle'` and renders anchored at the flat edge (bottom-center) of the half-arc, which is the same anchor point used for the full circle's center.
`isBoolean` works with `variant: 'semicircle'` - the forced primary/secondary-gray fill logic is angle-range agnostic and needs no changes.

SegmentLabel and rich segment label children are not supported when `variant: 'semicircle'` - they must be silently omitted (no marks rendered), mirroring the existing `isBoolean` exclusion pattern in segmentLabelUtils.ts, rather than rendering with the current (full-circle-only) hemisphere-cascade math and producing incorrect output.

The empty-state ring (shown when there's no data or the metric sums to zero) mirrors the semicircle's start/end angle and anchor point, so the empty state doesn't render as a full circle while real data renders as a half.

edgeCases.case: Empty data / metric sums to zero
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The empty-state gray ring renders as a matching half-ring (same startAngle/endAngle/anchor as the real arc), not a full circle.
Renders as a single half-ring segment spanning the full 180 degrees; no different from a single-segment full circle other than the sweep range.
Unaffected - color scale domain construction doesn't depend on sweep angle.

edgeCases.case: segmentLabels or rich segment labels supplied alongside variant: 'semicircle'
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Labels are not rendered (silently omitted), consistent with the isBoolean precedent. Documented as unsupported in this iteration.
Renders a half-donut with the primary segment in its set color and the secondary segment forced to secondary-gray, identical fill logic to the full-circle boolean case.

edgeCases.case: Data not pre-sorted descending by metric
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: With the default sortOrder of valueDescending, the spec builder reorders segments descending by metric before the pie transform runs.
With sortOrder set to data, the spec builder omits its sort transform and preserves the caller's source row order.
Ties retain their relative input order (stable sort), matching Vega's own 'sort' transform stability guarantee.
Unaffected - all existing color/background token usage (BACKGROUND_COLOR signal, gray-400/gray-200) is untouched by this feature.
This spec is S2-only. S1's donutSpecBuilder.ts/donutUtils.ts are not touched; a follow-up spec would be needed to port this to s1 - see openQuestions.

The radius expression continues to be a function of width/height so it responds to container resizing the same way the circle variant does, just using height instead of height/2 as the limiting dimension when height is the constraint.
No change - tooltip/inspect encodings are unaffected by sweep angle.
Hover, controlled-highlight, and legend-highlight opacity/fill rules are angle-agnostic and require no changes.

crossCutting.notes: Semicircle stories include highlighted Legend interaction, so a legend-paired donut must emit its hovered-item signal and register as an interactive mark even without SegmentLabel, ChartInspect, or ChartPopover children. S1 parity remains intentionally deferred because the semicircle variant is S2-only.

implementationPlan.change: Add `variant?: 'circle' | 'semicircle'` and `sortOrder?: 'valueDescending' | 'data'` to DonutOptions. Add both fields to the DonutOptionsWithDefaults union.

Destructure `variant = 'circle'` and `sortOrder = 'valueDescending'` in addDonut's produce callback. Change the `startAngle = 0` default to a variant-aware default (`variant === 'semicircle' ? -Math.PI / 2 : 0`) evaluated after `variant` is known. Update getPieTransforms' endAngle from `startAngle + 2 * PI` to `startAngle + (variant === 'semicircle' ? PI : 2 * PI)`, threading variant into the function's destructured options. In addData, add the descending metric sort only when `variant === 'semicircle' && sortOrder === 'valueDescending'`; omit it for `sortOrder === 'data'`.

Introduce variant-aware radius and anchor helpers, bypass SegmentLabel radius reservation for semicircles because those labels are omitted, mirror the semicircle sweep in the empty state, and treat a highlighted Legend as donut interactivity so arc hover opacity drives the matching legend item.

Add a new constant for the semicircle base-radius expression (mirroring DONUT_RADIUS's shape), e.g. DONUT_SEMICIRCLE_RADIUS = '(min(width, height) - 2)', for donutUtils.ts's variant-aware radius helper to reference.

Update the three `x: { signal: 'width / 2' }, y: { signal: 'height / 2' }` anchor pairs (title/value/label text marks) to use the same variant-aware y anchor as the arc (`height` for semicircle) so the summary stays centered under the half-arc's flat edge.

Extend the existing `if (isBoolean) return [];` / `if (donutOptions.isBoolean) return [];` guards in getSegmentLabelMarksForLabel and getRichSegmentLabelMarks (and the equivalent data-generation guard near line 353) to also short-circuit when `donutOptions.variant === 'semicircle'`, so labels are silently omitted rather than rendering with full-circle hemisphere math against a half arc.
Destructure and default `variant = 'circle'` and `sortOrder = 'valueDescending'` alongside the other prop defaults this render-null component holds.
No change expected - `variant` passes through automatically via the existing `...donutProps` spread into DonutOptions. Verify with a test.
Add the default sortOrder to the DonutSpecOptions fixture for use across donut tests.

Add tests covering: default startAngle resolution for variant: 'semicircle', the pie transform's endAngle for semicircle vs circle, ordering modes, highlighted-Legend hover signals/usermeta, and that segmentLabels supplied with variant: 'semicircle' produce no label marks.
Add tests for the variant-aware radius expression and the variant-aware arc/empty-state anchor (x/y) encodes.
Add tests asserting `variant: 'semicircle'` and `sortOrder: 'data'` pass through getDonutOptions unchanged.
New story file with plain, ordinal source-order, and isBoolean semicircle examples using bindWithProps.
Document the `variant` and `sortOrder` props, including value-descending default behavior, source-order preservation for ordinal categories, and the unsupported SegmentLabel limitation.
